scope: Owned finite binary16/alpha/crop control on four document Canvas contexts; not broad HDR or privacy admission.

limitations: Four HTML/Offscreen times sRGB/P3 contexts on a finite 16x16 Float16 fixture, one baseline/protected profile.
Native negative, above-one and subnormal samples are present; alpha/nonopaque colors and zero/subnormal channels stay unchanged.
Opaque changes preserve sign/exponent, affect at most one mantissa bit per channel and stay within max(1/256, one ULP).
Repeat, re-put, crop and input-buffer controls pass; this does not prove arbitrary image-editor/HDR or nonfinite-input behavior.
The policy requires adjacent finite opaque colors; not every isolated or transparent drawing changes.
No worker HDR, 001-073 runtime, anti-bot, security or release admission.
